title: [MacOS] Godot crashes upon close when using Metal due to non-existent cache entry
body: ### Tested versions master @ f964fa714f503bd063b96f6194eb3e45355c1084 Not present in 4.7-stable ### System information Godot v4.8.dev - macOS Tahoe (26.4.1) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M4 Max (Apple9) - Apple M4 Max (16 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (44100 Hz, Surround 3.1) ### Issue description Godot crashes upon close when using the Metal driver and any shaders were instantiated (i.e. anything other than the project picker). I suspect that this happened in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/119123. The culprit seems to be here; MDLibrary is hanging onto a pointer to a freed ShaderCacheEntry: Call stack: ```c++ HashMap, DefaultTypedAllocator>>::_lookup_idx(SHA256Digest const&, unsigned int&) instantiated (which the 3D panel always does, regardless of scene) Close the editor Observe crash ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Happens with any project if you use the Metal rendering driver.
